question: How many different products did customers in France buy in Q1 2024?

answer_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT sl.product_key) AS "how many different products"
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS sl
JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS c
  ON sl.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE
  c.country_code = 'FR'
  AND sl.order_date BETWEEN CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2024-03-31' AS DATE)
